reviews.text: We had our roof replaced after hail damage, and Apex Premier Roofing exceeded our expectations. Huy and his crew were professional, communicative, and easy to work with from start to finish. They walked us through the inspection, handled the process smoothly, and delivered a great-looking new roof. We’re extremely happy with the results and would definitely recommend them to anyone needing roof repairs or replacement.
reviews.author: Leo Xu

reviews.text: We recently had our roof replaced due to hail damage, and this Apex Premier Roofing company did an outstanding job. Ryan Zubrod was very professional, responsive, and guided us through the entire process from inspection to completion. The crew worked efficiently, used quality materials, and made sure everything was cleaned up afterward. The new roof looks great, and we feel confident knowing it was done right. Highly recommend them to anyone dealing with hail damage or needing a roof replacement!
reviews.author: Nikhil Maddy

reviews.text:
I have had several of roofing companies worked on my different houses in the past, and this is the first time I am so satisfied with Apex premiere  roofing. I must say that this is the best company . Above the best, yes. The representative (Jacob Jones) Apex had helped me from A to Z to have my house completed done from roofing to fence. He is nice gentleman to work with.
As for me. He is above the best that hardly meet in all fields of business.
I wish to give him 10 stars instead of only 5.
Besides, I have introduced Jacob to some of my friends.  All of them are so satisfied.
Love Apex premiere roofing
reviews.author: Hang Pham

reviews.text: Thank you Huy, Chris, and Osmond!!!  From the beginning to end this was the most smooth, professional, seamless, and easiest process for my roof replacement.    I’m very impressed with the professionalism and attention to detail that the team provided during my roof replacement.   From the claim process, to the project on-site everything was top notch.  I had a conversation with Osmond and I was impressed with his mentality, which is not common anymore, on always doing a great job no matter what and leaving the site with happy customers.  Not only do they have great customer service, but also provide quality materials.   They provide updates during your installation with high resolution photos and drone flights!   I will definitely be recommending Apex to my friends and family and I will personally not deal with another roofing company other than Apex!  Do not hesitate to give these guys a call for your next roof replacement.
reviews.author: Araceli Fernandez

reviews.text: I typically do not answer the door for solicitors, but this day was different. I met CJ Roberson as he was passing through the neighborhood, and he was immediately friendly and struck me as trustworthy. Some salesmen can make you feel uncomfortable or pressured as they give their pitches. However, CJ's demeanor and confidence let me know he was honest and looking out for me, the customer. We agreed to pursue the claim for a roof replacement based on my insurance coverage provisions as well as the fact that a qualifying storm had recently moved through the area. His team immediately went to work, taking pictures, working up quotes, and contacting their contractors to get the ball rolling. CJ was excellent with keeping me updated on the moving parts, explaining the process, keeping all the financials transparent, and answering any questions I had. The best part was that his approach let me know he was looking out for me, and his team's goal was to maximize the amount recovered from the insurance company, not at my own expense. So knowing that I had an expert in my corner, we took full advantage of every recoverable component that would qualify under the insurance coverage. On the date of install, he had an associate show up to take drone footage while the reroof unfolded. This on site project manager was great! And he and CJ were available during the whole day. The work was completed on time and professionally accomplished. Additional repair items, separate from the roof, were completed at a later date by other contractors. Although our financial transactions were complete, CJ did not stop working for me to ensure the whole project was done to my satisfaction. We encountered a small hiccup due to rain, which necessitated a return by one of the contractors to fix a few boards (due to the rain). CJ maintained his usual level of commitment and continuous communication to get the touch-ups completed. I'm so thankful for CJ, his team, and Apex Premier Roofing for the work they did at my home!
reviews.author: Chris Davidson

reviews.text: Amazing work you guys!! I was thoroughly impressed as I was initially quoted eight hours, and everything was done within FIVE!! You guys were professional, and got in and out with no issues! Apex Premier Roofing will definitely be my go to, if I need future services done! Thank you Eric for all that you assisted with, and being in constant communication with everything. The professionalism is TOP TIER! TENS ACROSS THE BOARD!!
reviews.author: michele donison

reviews.text: Big shout out to Mike, Paul, and the Apex Premier team for the professionalism and care they put into replacing our roof! From the prompt courteous communication, to the experienced and skilled labor, to the care they put into protecting our property during the replacement - we couldn't be happier with the process and results. We'd gladly use them again and have already referred this trustworthy team to our family and friends.
reviews.author: Teresa Nguyen

reviews.text: Jacob Jones and Paul Pham at Apex Premier Roofing are an amazing team! Jacob handled everything as the project manager and kept me informed every step of the way, while Paul made sure the work was done perfectly. Their communication was excellent, the crew was professional, and they left my property spotless. The roof looks fantastic — I couldn’t be happier. Highly recommend Jacob, Paul, and the Apex Premier Roofing team!
reviews.author: Kayla Williams
